entries.title: The Oversight Board says Meta needs to do more to protect regular people from sexualized deepfakes
entries.summary: Meta's Oversight Board has made several suggestions to make reporting sexualized AI deepfakes easier and more effective for ordinary people.
entries.excerpt: Meta's Oversight Boardhas called on the social media company to strengthen its protection for ordinary people targeted by sexualized deepfakes. The Board recommends the addition of AI-generated impersonations in Meta's Adult Sexual Exploitation policy, arguing that those images and videos are non-consensual by default. It also wants Meta to allow users to designate "connected accounts," such as trusted friends and family, who can report potential violations like non-consensual intimate imagery on their behalf.
